title: SSC CHSL Tier 1 — Free Mock Test 1

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11
questions.explanation: 9 is not a prime number; all others (3,5,7,11) are prime.

questions.q: If ROAD is coded as URDG, how is SWAN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +3: S→V, W→X, A→D, N→Q = VXDQ.

questions.q: In a row of 40 students, Riya is 15th from the left. What is her position from the right?
questions.explanation: 40 - 15 + 1 = 26th from the right.

questions.q: Pointing to a man, a woman says 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of my mother = the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman.

questions.q: Complete the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
Which Venn diagram best represents: Doctors, Surgeons, Humans?
questions.explanation: All surgeons are doctors, all doctors are humans — concentric circles.

questions.q: A is the brother of B. C is the mother of A. D is the father of C. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: D is C's father; C is B's mother; so D is B's maternal grandfather.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is Accommodation (double c, double m).

questions.q: Select the synonym of BENEVOLENT:
questions.explanation: Benevolent means well-meaning and kindly; synonym is charitable.

questions.q: The antonym of VERBOSE is:
questions.explanation: Verbose means using more words than needed; antonym is concise.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She _____ to the market every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Third person singular present tense takes 'goes'.

questions.q: Identify the correctly punctuated sentence:
questions.explanation: It's = it is; requires apostrophe. Full stop at end.

questions.q: Choose the one-word substitution for: 'One who walks in sleep'
questions.explanation: Somnambulist means a sleepwalker.

questions.q: The passive voice of 'She writes a letter' is:
options: A letter is written by her
A letter was written by her
A letter has been written by her
questions.explanation: Simple present active → 'is/are + past participle' in passive.

questions.q: A train 150m long passes a pole in 15 seconds. Its speed is:
If 8 men can complete a work in 20 days, in how many days can 16 men complete it?
questions.explanation: Work = 8×20 = 160 man-days. 16 men → 160/16 = 10 days.

questions.q: What is 15% of 480?
The simple interest on ₹2000 at 5% per annum for 3 years is:
The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 25. The excluded number is:
Who wrote the national song 'Vande Mataram'?
questions.explanation: Vande Mataram was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee and is from his novel Anandamath (1882).

questions.q: The Headquarters of ISRO is located in:
questions.explanation: ISRO's headquarters is in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka.

questions.q: Which is the largest planet in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

questions.q: The 'Battle of Plassey' was fought in:
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey was fought on June 23, 1757 between the British East India Company and the Nawab of Bengal.

questions.q: Which gas is known as 'laughing gas'?
questions.explanation: Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is commonly known as laughing gas.
